metadata.user_request: make a simple EMA crossover strategy that uses 30 and 70 periods crossing each other for entry. Open long positions when 30 ema crosses above 70 ema and enter short position when 70 ema crosses below 30 ema. The stop loss should be set 15 pips from entry and take profit should be 70 pips from entry

items.title: Implement Complete EMA Crossover Strategy
items.description: Implement complete trading strategy with all components: (1) Data loading and preprocessing from CSV/API with OHLCV validation, (2) Indicator calculation for 30-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and 70-period EMA, (3) Entry conditions: Open long position when 30 EMA crosses above 70 EMA; Open short position when 30 EMA crosses below 70 EMA, (4) Exit conditions: Set stop loss at 15 pips from entry price and take profit at 70 pips from entry price, (5) Complete backtest runner using an adapter-driven architecture (e.g., SimBroker). Include explicit loop termination conditions (e.g., max_iterations), robust error handling, and comprehensive logging. Ensure the strategy is production-ready and fully testable.
